description: POST {prefix}/scheduled-jobs (flowcatalyst contract section 4 and 4a slice 5, follow-ups 3 and 4). Setup common to every case: application 'orders', signing secret 'whsec-test-only', clock 2026-10-09T12:00:00Z, one job handler registered under code 'nightly-export', a lock instance (unless lock says otherwise), the service principal available, the platform answering completion calls 204, the completion retry delay 10 ms. handler kinds: success; result (arg = JSON the handler returns); failure (arg = message); throw (arg = message); throwBlank (throws with no message); null (returns null); hang (blocks until interrupted); longString (arg = N: returns a string of N 'x'); unserialisable (a result whose JSON cannot be written). options: exclusive (the default) or alwaysConcurrent. lock: free | held (another owner holds scheduled-job:nightly-export with a long lease) | down (the lock store is unreachable) | none (no lock instance) | lost (the lease expires, on the monotonic clock, while the handler runs). env overrides the receivers settings (job-timeout, job-lock-lease). completionFailures: the first N completion calls are answered 500. completionCalls: how many completion calls the platform receives in total. The request body is the JSON of 'envelope' (or rawBody when present), signed unless sign is false. expect: status and body (parsed JSON; messageJava on a 400 is Java's wording and is not compared); handlerRuns; firing (what the handler was handed, null when it did not run: fencingTokenPresent, timeoutSeconds, contextClient, executionId, causationId, correlationId ('<generated>' = any non-blank value other than the envelope's)); completions = the calls the platform received in order, each {path, body}. A 400 or 404 or 401 runs nothing. The call is answered 202 before the handler finishes; completions are read after they arrive.
howToRun: Per case: start the receiver with the setup above, put the lock in the state named, POST the signed body, wait for completionCalls completion requests (and, when 0, 300 ms of quiet), compare status, body, handlerRuns, firing and completions. Regenerate from Java with -Dconformance.update=true (ScheduledJobsVectorConformanceTest).
